name: app_puede_escribir
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_puede_escribir()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  select case when app_es_vip() then true else coalesce(
    (select u.puede_escribir and u.activo from app_usuarios u where u.user_id = auth.uid() limit 1), false) end;
$function$

name: control_es_admin_cierre
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.control_es_admin_cierre()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.app_usuarios u
    join public.config c on c.clave='admin_papelera'
    where u.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and u.activo and u.rol='ADMIN'
      and u.puede_eliminar and lower(u.email)=lower(c.valor->>'email')
  );
$function$

name: control_generar_cheques_pendientes
control_puede_eliminar_cheques
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.control_puede_eliminar_cheques()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (select auth.uid()) is not null and (
    public.control_es_admin_cierre() or exists (
      select 1 from public.control_permisos_cheques p
      join public.app_usuarios u on u.user_id=p.user_id
      where p.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and p.puede_eliminar
        and u.activo and u.puede_escribir
    )
  );
$function$
